messages:
harpreet: Quick sprint-sync after the postmortem. We need a tight plan for GPU capacity changes + autoscaler tuning that fits in a 2-week sprint. Can we pick owners and minimal verification steps?

fiona: I can own the sprint epic for capacity. My proposal: split into 3 cards - (1) headroom sims, (2) scheduler canary, (3) quota procurement path. Aim to close all in 10 working days.

sanjay: I'll take scheduler canary + rollback automation. Plan: conservative config diff, 36h canary, emergency drain dry-run before traffic cutover. Will post config by tomorrow.

zack: I'll run headroom sims and cost burn numbers. Will produce zone-by-zone heatmaps and a 30-day cost projection. Need a staging cluster with matching GPU SKU matrix.

ops-bot: [automated] Created epic INC-SPRINT-2027 and tasks: SPR-2027-01 (headroom-sim), SPR-2027-02 (scheduler-canary), SPR-2027-03 (quota-procurement).

fiona: tracker row: https://go.redwood/incident-2027 added owners + acceptance criteria. Keep verification to a single checklist item per card to move fast.

harpreet: ownership summary: zack=headroom sims + cost, sanjay=scheduler canary + rollback, fiona=epic + coordination + PD alerts. Deadlines: config by tomorrow, sims start in 24h, canary mid-week.

sanjay: config snippet preview (will push full diff to tracker):
```
# scheduler conservative tweak
scoreWeights:
  binpack: 1.05
  balance: 0.95
preemption:
  enabled: true
  minPriorityDiff: 2000
evictionWindowMs: 30
```

zack: sims plan: baseline replay (48h), then +15% spike (24h), then sustained +25% (24h). I'll capture p50/p95/p99/p999 and tail util by zone & SKU.

fiona: procurement note: any reserved bump >12% needs exec approval. For sprint tests, finance ok'd short-term burst credits (cap $8k). zack, include cost projection under that cap first.

harpreet: add a preflight checklist: 1) dry-run emergency drain, 2) smoke test against small LLM model, 3) metrics alert sanity (p999, tail-util, queue-length). Who runs dry-run?

sanjay: I'll run dry-run and post logs; assign an oncall to monitor. ops-bot: create task -> SPR-2027-02a owner=sanjay due=2026-04-05.

ops-bot: [automated] Created task SPR-2027-02a: Emergency-drain dry-run. Assigned to sanjay. Due=2026-04-05.

zack: cluster request submitted (CL-505). ETA kubeconfig in tracker in ~8h. Will tag by zone and driver version.

fiona: added a temporary PD rule: sprint-tail-watch (PD-2105) -> fire if tail-util > 80% for 45m during tests. Linked runbook in tracker.

harpreet: verification criteria to close epic: (A) two sims with <=5% increase in overall cost and tail p999 within target; OR (B) scheduler canary reduces p999 by >=12% without cost >7%. Decide after results.

sanjay: fail-fast thresholds: abort canary if p999 up >10% or queue-length increases 30%+. Will automate rollback if threshold hit.

zack: I'll include a small experiment for KV cache priming to reduce cold-start token cost; note that in cost delta.

fiona: scheduling: daily 15m standup for the sprint on #incidents for two weeks, ops-bot create recurrence. ops-bot: recurrence created ID R-SPRINT-2027.

ops-bot: [automated] Created recurring standup R-SPRINT-2027: daily 15m at 15:00 UTC for 10 business days.

harpreet: thanks all. We'll use the tracker for all artifacts; post only short status updates to this thread. Reconvene EOD for config review.

ops-bot: [automated reminder] Config review scheduled -> 2026-04-04 17:00 UTC. Reminder 30m prior.
